table.retrieve:
SELECT
	dbo.item.icode,
	dbo.item.customicode,
	dbo.item.name, 
	localitemname = dbo.item.localitemname,
	dbo.item.manfcode, 
	dbo.item.packunits,
	dbo.item.purprice,
	SalePrice = CASE (SELECT G.SalePriceInItemList FROM Groups G WHERE G.GroupCode = :ai_GroupCode) 
						WHEN 2 THEN dbo.item.saleprice2
						WHEN 3 THEN dbo.item.saleprice3
						WHEN 4 THEN dbo.item.saleprice4
						WHEN 5 THEN dbo.item.saleprice5
						ELSE dbo.item.saleprice END, 
	dbo.Manufacturer.name,
	stock = (select	sum(dbo.godowndetail.currqty)
		from	dbo.godowndetail 
		where	dbo.godowndetail.icode = dbo.item.icode),
	sstock = CASE WHEN (SELECT salegodownstrategy FROM Groups Where GroupCode = :ai_GroupCode) = 2  THEN
		(select	sum(dbo.godowndetail.currqty)
		from	dbo.godowndetail
		where	dbo.godowndetail.icode = dbo.item.icode and
			dbo.godowndetail.gcode = item.GCode)
		ELSE
			(select	sum(dbo.godowndetail.currqty)
			from	dbo.godowndetail,
				(SELECT DISTINCT GCode From GroupAllowedGodown
				WHERE	GroupAllowedGodown.GroupCode = :ai_GroupCode AND
					GroupAllowedGodown.Module = 1) T
			where	dbo.godowndetail.icode = dbo.item.icode and
				dbo.godowndetail.gcode = T.GCode)
		END,
	pstock = CASE WHEN (SELECT purchasegodownstrategy FROM Groups Where GroupCode = :ai_GroupCode) = 2  THEN
		(select	sum(dbo.godowndetail.currqty)
		from	dbo.godowndetail
		where	dbo.godowndetail.icode = dbo.item.icode and
			dbo.godowndetail.gcode = item.GCode)
		ELSE
			(select	sum(dbo.godowndetail.currqty)
			from	dbo.godowndetail,
				(SELECT DISTINCT GCode From GroupAllowedGodown
				WHERE	GroupAllowedGodown.GroupCode = :ai_GroupCode AND
					GroupAllowedGodown.Module = 3) T
			where	dbo.godowndetail.icode = dbo.item.icode and
				dbo.godowndetail.gcode = T.GCode)
		END,
	Packing = dbo.itempacking.name,
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
	dbo.item.restricted,
	dbo.item.icatcode,
	dbo.item.iccode,
	dbo.item.packcode,
	dbo.item.itemalertcode,
	itemalerttypecode = (select ia.itemalerttypecode from itemalert ia where ia.itemalertcode = item.itemalertcode),
	dbo.item.isizecode,
	dbo.item.istylecode,
	dbo.item.icolourcode,
	dbo.item.iyarncode,
	dbo.item.isleevecode,
	dbo.item.ifabriccode,
	dbo.item.ibrandcode,
	dbo.item.ipartcode,
	dbo.item.oldpartcode,
	dbo.item.genericcode,
	dbo.item.location,
	itempartno = (select itempart.name from itempart where itempart.ipartcode = dbo.item.ipartcode),
	transitstock=item.transitstock,
	BGColor = (SELECT IA.BGColor FROM ItemAlert IA WHERE IA.ItemAlertCode = dbo.item.itemalertcode)
FROM	
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.Manufacturer,
	(Select ICatCode FROM ItemCategory WHERE Upper(DBO.Fn_GetPreference('GroupCategoryRights')) = 'Y' AND ICatCode IN (:ai_catlist)
	UNION
	Select ICatCode FROM ItemCategory WHERE Upper(DBO.Fn_GetPreference('GroupCategoryRights')) = 'N' UNION SELECT ICatCode=0)  P
	
WHERE
	dbo.item.Active = 1 and
	dbo.Manufacturer.manfcode = dbo.item.manfcode and
	dbo.item.ICatCode = P.ICatCode

ORDER BY dbo.item.name
